capabilities: Builds a segmented Chinese and English index using Intl.Segmenter
Ranks results with BM25 and boosts title matches
Updates the index incrementally on save
Configures result limits, excluded folders, and manual reindexing
extras: Freemium: core search is free and open source, but planned Pro features (pinyin search, fuzzy-tone tolerance, large-vault performance) are sold via a paid 爱发电 subscription; the plugin was awaiting community market review at the time of the README.
motivation: The author built it because native search is substring-only and was designed without Chinese tokenization in mind.
problem: Obsidian's native search does substring matching, so Chinese queries like 「笔记管理」 fail to find text where 「笔记」 and 「管理」 appear separately, with no segmentation or relevance ordering.
summary: Chinese full-text search plugin that adds word segmentation and BM25 relevance ranking to find results the native substring search misses.
